definitions.explanation: Extremely large in amount, scale, or extent.

examples.japanese: {莫大|ばくだい}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It cost an enormous amount of money.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{莫大|ばくだい}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{財産|ざいさん}→財産：01635_zaisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{相続|そうぞく}した→相続：03690_souzoku⟧。
{莫大|ばくだい}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}えて→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: They are burdened with an enormous debt.

notes:
Used to describe extremely large amounts, especially of money, resources, or abstract quantities.

FORMS:
- {莫大|ばくだい}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun
- {莫大|ばくだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb (rarely used)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {莫大|ばくだい}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧ (enormous cost)
- {莫大|ばくだい}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{財産|ざいさん}→財産：01635_zaisan⟧ (vast fortune)
- {莫大|ばくだい}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧ (huge debt)
- {莫大|ばくだい}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧ (enormous profit)
- {莫大|ばくだい}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧ (tremendous damage)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{膨大|ぼうだい}→膨大：08997_boudai⟧ - immense (often for volume or data)
- ⟦{巨大|きょだい}→巨大：02586_kyodai⟧ - huge (physical size)
- {莫大|ばくだい} - enormous (typically for amounts, money)
